note: Real MATLAB R2025a Simulink algebraic loop: the closed model is solved by the Simulink algebraic-loop solver (y_sim); the expanded model (same block set) computes the loop function G(y) and the residual r(y)=y-G(y) with real blocks; HGCA solves r(y)=0 and is compared with y_sim; PCU/struct_id is expected to not trigger (no periodic structure).
